marco: quick heads-up: deployed a microbatch/prefetch tweak to a 5% canary at 13:20 UTC to cut short-request p50 and token waste.
tara: what did you change?
marco: two small knobs: microbatch coalescing window lowered to 6 tokens when qps<60; prefetch now prioritizes hot prefixes and pre-allocates decode buffers for responses <40 tokens.
ben: bench numbers?
marco: 30m live-replay: for <32 tokens p50 8ms->3.5ms (~56%), p95 42ms->28ms (~33%), p99 240ms->200ms (~17%). Token cost per 1M down ~13%.
tara: any regressions?
marco: saw a transient p99 bump on one AZ tied to a noisy daemon; patched it and metrics returned to baseline. No quality impact.
ben: paste config so QE can repro.
marco: pasted: {"microbatch_max_window":6, "microbatch_qps_threshold":60, "prefetch_hot_prefixes":["/reply","/search"], "prefetch_buffer_ms":5}
ops-bot: perf-run perf_2026_10_11_1320 dashboard https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/2300001234
tara: rollout plan?
marco: expand 5%->25% (30m)->60% (1h)->100% with p99 long-seq gate and quick rollback flags. Ops window 23:00 UTC.
ben: add medium-seq probe to smoke tests.
marco: will do. TL;DR: small microbatch+prefetch tweaks -> solid short-tail wins and ~13% cost saving; staged rollout tonight. :tada:
